name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship
description: AICTE Saksham Scholarship encourages differently-abled students to pursue technical degree and diploma programs in AICTE-approved institutions.
descriptionHindi: दिव्यांग विद्यार्थियों को इंजीनियरिंग एवं तकनीकी शिक्षा जारी रखने हेतु प्रोत्साहित करने वाली छात्रवृत्ति योजना।
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for the duration of the technical course to cover tuition fees, books, equipment, and assistive software/devices.
benefitsHindi: तकनीकी पाठ्यक्रम की अवधि के दौरान प्रति वर्ष ₹50,000 की छात्रवृत्ति सहायता।
eligibilityText: Differently-abled students with not less than 40% benchmark disability admitted to AICTE-approved technical degree/diploma courses with family income up to ₹8.00 lakh.
eligibilityTextHindi: 40% या अधिक दिव्यांगता वाले छात्र जो तकनीकी पाठ्यक्रम में अध्ययनरत हों तथा पारिवारिक आय ₹8 लाख तक हो।
sourceName: All India Council for Technical Education
